resources.string: RhythHaus plays local files only. It does not stream or upload your music.
Add a folder and keep its files available to RhythHaus.
We scan metadata and artwork for WAV, AIFF, AU, MP3, M4A/AAC, FLAC, and OGG files. Skipped items are reported.
If music is moved, deleted, or access is lost, rescan the source. Remove missing tracks only from the source recovery flow.
Android folder access is granted through the system folder picker.
iOS copies files into Documents/RhythHaus, or scans files already there in place.
macOS keeps a reference to the folder you choose; files remain where they are.
